title: Find out whether a new video should keep the length it was given once a title goes on it
goal: A video started with File > New Video at a length of its own (say 10 seconds) drops to 4 seconds the moment a title page is put on it, because the title is all there is on it. Decide whether the chosen length should hold until something longer lands, and make it so if it should.
notes: Seen 2026-10-19 by the runner through the agent tools on the probe: new_video {width:1920,height:1080,seconds:6} answered durationSeconds 6; add_title {seconds:0, style:"Keynote Clean", text:"Hello"} answered durationSeconds 4. Cause: PhotonzDocument.landTitle calls refreshDuration(), which sets durationMS to the latest out point whenever a duration is written. Not checked through the menu by a person; it may be meant (a video is as long as what is on it, the rule a trim follows). Found during an-agent-can-cut-a-video-from-history-clips-with.
acceptance: The behaviour a person gets is decided and written in the task log
If the length should hold: a 10 second new video with a 4 second title page put on it is still 10 seconds long, and a walk shows it
